owner: Exact project owner through ordinary native file/command permissions; choice grants no entitlement or app-write authority

choices.local_enabled: boolean or UNKNOWN on absent/invalid readback
choices.default: UNKNOWN; never seed On from plugin installation or baseline approval

writes: Explicit read/set/pause/resume CLI; current revision CAS, atomic save; unqualified pause remembers the actual prior Local/Cloud pair; resume never assumes both On. No global/vendor/shared service setting.

sessions.scope: Bounded operational latest-request/dedupe/failure control only; no transcript/raw prompt/source/log or append-only history
sessions.both_off: No automatic assistance/new capture. Bounded cleanup touches only validated owned session records; revision binding makes retained records inert, never a replay backlog.
sessions.one_shot: Store only context/revision/turn/one-shot and exact READ-protection control, no signal/task hash/time/failure/dedupe data; clear next ordinary prompt/Stop/new session. No saved-choice write or host behavioral recorder/replay. Both Off suppresses service capture; either saved On retains the existing service policy.
sessions.revision_binding: Every operational record is bound to the current preference revision; any saved choice change invalidates old counters/signals/tokens even if bounded cleanup did not visit that session.

events.codex_hooks: Manual desktop distribution and exact hook trust review required; not official-directory hook support

cosmetic: No Cloud retrieval solely for a simple reversible label/style/typo task
delivery: Hooks emit bounded context, never network calls; native agent retrieves actual applicable guidance through existing authenticated MCP. Source/hook delivery is not observed useful behavior.
service_sync: Existing bos_assistance_preference READ then SYNC exact project/app_revision/expected_revision; native compatibility owned separately. Missing sync is not an editor lock.
native_one_shot_transport: Current live wire support plus authenticated exact-project preference READ from the separately qualified enrollment-gated service; exact matching saved app_revision/pair with Cloud Off or enrolled NO_SAVED_CHOICE. Schema alone is insufficient. Both Off suppresses new service capture/backlog; Local-On/Cloud-Off retains existing saved-switch capture policy. Optional host recording stays conservative. No automatic SYNC, newer-choice overwrite, Off-to-On or token relay.
ordinary_security: Existing identity/entitlement/app security/destructive/publication gates remain; no tool auto-approval or trust bypass
qualification: Parent ten-case-per-host matrix OPEN until exact loaded/trusted native source shows retrieval and useful unsolicited suggestions.
dedupe: Bounded16-entry cache keyed by normalized current task hash plus source/binding and preference revision. Failure key also includes normalized tool name and bounded tool-input hash, so a different task or command/edit does not inherit suppression. Raw text/output is never retained; paraphrase equivalence needs native judgment.
intent: Literal/quoted/pasted examples are not one-shot authorization; keyword categories are candidate relevance only. Native semantic task judgment remains required; cosmetic labels do not become consequential from quoted roles/permissions words.
service_dependency: Current production native support is unqualified. READ must be gated on actual native rollout selection by the reviewed service successor. Hook parsing cannot authenticate callbacks or independently attest provider flags; native/service release verification is required before a capture-protection claim.
